articles.title: Don't let iPhone Duo go unprotected, these are the best case options so far
articles.description: The best iPhone Duo cases protect Apple's foldable without getting in the way of its hinge, with options ranging from slim MagSafe shells to rugged designs with reinforced protection. iPhone Duo cases A conventional iPhone case only needs to fit around one solid body. The iPhone Duo introduces another consideration with its folding hinge, which needs to move freely while the rest of the phone stays protected. Case makers have approached the challenge in different ways. Some favor thin shells that preserve the phone's original dimensions, while others offer dedicated hinge protection, integrated stands, and reinforced corners. We've rounded up seven iPhone Duo cases from Spigen, Torras, ESR, and OtterBox, with options ranging from lightweight everyday protection to more rugged designs.
